name: Memory Link Evolution
description: Memory links between entities evolve over time: new links, deprecated links, superseded links. The link graph maintains temporal metadata for each edge.
purpose: Ensure the memory knowledge graph accurately reflects the current state of relationships between entities, with full historical tracking of how links have changed over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Memory links are first-class entities with temporal metadata
Links support creation, deprecation, and supersession
Deprecated links are preserved in history but excluded from active queries
Superseded links point to their replacement
Link evolution is tracked with timestamps and provenance
Link graph supports temporal queries — 'what links existed at time T'
rollback_strategy: Restore previous link state; roll back link evolution journal
recovery_strategy: Rebuild link graph from link evolution journal
